independent_linguistic_review.scope: Single AI author reviews displays and keys; separate code-path reconstruction is structural only.

batches.editorial_review_scope: Single AI author reads every selected word and default key in context, then records positional polyphone decisions. Structural reconstruction is a separate code path, not an independent linguistic editor. Individually authored natural vocabulary, no copied corpus sentences or private text.
